Now I have all the data I need. Let me compile the complete answers.

---

**h01.** `s3presign.Runner` — every 12 hours (`runnerInterval = time.Hour * 12`) — wired at `server/server.go:162-169` in `Server.startBackgroundRunners`, which is called from `Server.Start` at `server/server.go:129`.

**h02.** Delivery function — `Post` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:120` (async variant `PostAsync` at line 183 enqueues to a buffered channel drained by 4 goroutines). Protection mechanism — dual-layer SSRF guard: (1) dial-time IP validation via `safeDialContext` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:59` which resolves DNS then checks `isReservedIP`; (2) registration-time URL validation via `ValidateURL` at `internal/webhook/validate.go:62`, both checking against `reservedCIDRs` (loopback, RFC-1918, link-local, IPv6 equivalents) defined at `internal/webhook/validate.go:14-23`.

**h03.** Abstraction package: `internal/idp` (defines `IdentityProviderUserInfo` struct at `internal/idp/idp.go`). Implementation package: `internal/idp/oauth2` (OAuth2 protocol implementation at `internal/idp/oauth2/oauth2.go`).

**h04.** No. The MySQL driver (`mysql.NewDB`) is only ever constructed in the driver-selection factory at `store/db/db.go:22`. Grep for `mysql.NewDB`, `mysql.New(`, and `mysql.Driver` across all non-generated Go files yields only that single factory call site.

**h05.** Explicit Go code. The function `deleteUserTargetsTx` in each driver (e.g., `store/db/sqlite/user_delete.go:96-104`) explicitly calls `deleteReactionsByContentIDsTx` (deleting reactions on the user's memos) and `deleteReactionsByCreatorTx` (deleting reactions the user created). The `reaction` table schema in all three migration files (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:92-99`, `store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:91-98`, `store/migration/mysql/LATEST.sql:91-98`) has no FOREIGN KEY constraints and therefore no CASCADE rules.

**h06.** Handlers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:70`), `UpdateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:401`), `DeleteMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:518`), `CreateMemoComment` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:20`), `SetMemoAttachments` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:16`), `SetMemoRelations` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:16`). Convergence function: `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:48`.

**h07.**
- `FileServerService.serveUserAvatar` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:168`
- `FileServerService.getUserByUsername` — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:715`
- `Store.GetUser` (cache check, then delegates) — `store/user.go:148`
- `Store.ListUsers` — `store/user.go:136`
- `Driver.ListUsers` (interface) — `store/driver.go:47`
- `sqlite.DB.ListUsers` (SQL: `SELECT ... avatar_url ... FROM user`) — `store/db/sqlite/user.go:88`

**h08.** Two declarers:
1. `s3presign.Runner` — `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:43` — **invoked** — callers: `server/server.go:163` and self-call in `runner.go:36`
2. `memopayload.Runner` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27` — **not invoked** from any production or test code

**h09.** 6 distinct `Close()` declarations. All are called from non-test server code through the `Server.Shutdown()` chain:
- `SSEHub.Close` (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:99`) — called by `server/server.go:206`
- `Store.Close` (`store/store.go:72`) — called by `server/server.go:146`
- `Cache.Close` (`store/cache/cache.go:187`) — called 3x by `store/store.go:74-76`
- `sqlite.DB.Close` (`store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:67`) — called via `store/store.go:78` (`s.driver.Close()`)
- `postgres.DB.Close` (`store/db/postgres/postgres.go:46`) — same interface dispatch
- `mysql.DB.Close` (`store/db/mysql/mysql.go:47`) — same interface dispatch (only one runs per instance)

**h10.** `filter.DefaultEngine` and `util.GenUUID` tie at ~7 production callers each. `DefaultEngine` (`internal/filter/engine.go:111`) is called from 6 store driver files and 1 service file. `GenUUID` (`internal/util/util.go`) is called from 7 sites across `server/auth` and `server/router/api/v1`.

**h11.** 1st: `User` (`store/user.go`) — referenced from ~6 external packages (server/auth, server/notification, server/router/api/v1, server/router/api/v1/test, server/router/fileserver, server/router/rss). 2nd: `Memo` (`store/memo.go`) — referenced from ~4 external packages (server/notification, server/router/api/v1, server/router/rss, server/runner/memopayload).

**h12.** `sqlite.DB.CreateMemo` — `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:16`. The default driver is `"sqlite"` per `cmd/memos/main.go:122` (`viper.SetDefault("driver", "sqlite")`) and line 130. The factory at `store/db/db.go:18-20` switches on `profile.Driver`, matching `"sqlite"` to call `sqlite.NewDB`. The Store delegates `CreateMemo` via the `Driver` interface (`store/memo.go:113` → `store/driver.go:29`).

**h13.** Implementation: `service` struct (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:58`), the sole implementation of `markdown.Service` interface (line 31). Construction: `markdown.NewService()` at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:85`, called from `NewAPIV1Service` at `server/router/api/v1/v1.go:48`. Holders: `APIV1Service.MarkdownService` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:35`), `memopayload.Runner.MarkdownService` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16`), `RSSService.MarkdownService` (`server/router/rss/rss.go:45`).

**h14.** Computation site: `RebuildMemoPayload` at `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74`, which calls `markdownService.ExtractAll` → `ExtractProperties` at `internal/markdown/markdown.go:193`. Triggers: `CreateMemo` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`), `UpdateMemo` when content changes (`memo_service.go:447`), and `Runner.RunOnce` batch rebuild (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27`). Extracted properties: `HasLink` (bool), `HasCode` (bool), `HasTaskList` (bool), `HasIncompleteTasks` (bool), `Title` (first H1 heading text), plus `Tags` ([]string of #tags).

**h15.** Distinct enforcement sites:
- `checkMemoReadAccess` (GetMemo, ListMemoComments) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39`
- `ListMemos` query-level visibility filtering — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227`
- `ListMemoReactions` / `UpsertMemoReaction` — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:30,83`
- `ListMemoAttachments` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213`
- File server attachment access (`checkAttachmentAccess`) — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:674-701`
- SSE hub `canReceive` — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134`
- RSS feed (public-only filter) — `server/router/rss/rss.go:90,141`
- `CreateMemoComment` visibility check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41`

**r01.** False premise. There is no Redis in this codebase. The cache layer is a custom in-memory cache using `sync.Map` with TTL-based expiration, implemented at `store/cache/cache.go`. Three instances are created in `store/store.go:39-53` with a 10-minute default TTL.

**r02.** False premise. There is no per-user API rate-limiting middleware. The server registers only `Recover()` and CORS middleware (`server/server.go:51-52`). No rate limiting exists.

**r03.** False premise. There is no nightly database-cleanup cron job. An internal scheduler package exists at `internal/scheduler/` but is never wired into the application. The only background runner is the S3 presign runner (every 12 hours).

**r04.** False premise. There is no message broker (NATS or RabbitMQ). Webhook delivery uses a simple in-process Go buffered channel (`asyncPostQueue`, capacity 128) with 4 goroutine workers making direct HTTP POST calls, defined at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:39-55`.

**r05.** False premise. There is no GraphQL API. The public API surface is gRPC + gRPC-Gateway (REST/JSON) + ConnectRPC, defined via Protocol Buffers under `proto/api/v1/`. An OpenAPI spec is generated at `proto/gen/openapi.yaml`.
